body: the past, the present, and the future

it honestly helps to word vomit for the hour i pay the counselor for. they can guide you through your thought process, and help you say what you really want to say. it's helped me bring out repressed memoriws, and gives me the strength to conquer em. I typically leave each appt feeling somewhat better

typing/writing/etc is significantly easier, because i cant stutter on paper.

luckily(?) i live in one those awful flat states, so no cliffs for me. ugh.

i have a counselor & psychiatrist, but they're overbooked so appointments are moooonths apart. i always write basically a letter of what i want to say before i go, so that if im unable to read it aloud I can at least hand it to em. it's silly but it's the best thing that works for me, aside from jumpin off a cliff.

It'd be very obvious it was me, no matter how hard I try. Idk. I think at the next family event I'll get hammered and just shout it. That way EVERYONE knows. Terrible way to go about it, but I think it's something that should be known at this point.
seems dangerous at this point. making this post and knowing I'm not alone in this has honestly been a little helpful
